classical:pca.note: gemm_tn_centered reads x_alias2, which pca_lean_scratch sizes; it only acts past the split-K width (d > 128). (pca_rr_one_block and pca_device_truncate, independent of the Gram switches, were removed 2026-10-09 / 2026-10-10.)

more:tsvd.route: fit: TruncatedSVD.fit -> tsvd_fit_explained [tsvd_one_upload] (tsvd_fit_device: gemm_tn + eig_and_truncate; _tsvd_explained_tail: gemm_nt + 2x _column_variance [colvar_fused])
